m2-rev-envelope.title: MAJOR-2: rev()'s docstring states an equality envelope wider than it is
m2-rev-envelope.imperative: Correct rev()'s docstring to state the real condition — equality with git hash-object needs BOTH no attribute exemption (-text/binary) AND content git is willing to normalise, since git also declines on content grounds (a NUL byte -> auto-binary; a lone CR -> the CRLF filter refuses). Name that the gate's .gitattributes grep covers only the attribute half. Add a characterization test to RevIsGitBlobOid pinning the known divergence against the git hash-object oracle, so the boundary is mechanically watched rather than assumed.

postconditions.statement: the new divergence test is discriminating, not vacuous — observed failing against a stand-in rev that skips normalisation (manual attest; a characterization test over existing behaviour cannot be red first)
all rev tests pass, including the new known-divergence pin

constraints: the identity function itself is settled and must NOT change
